text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Cabinet reviews military measures to confront potential Iraqi threats.
- Gulf Investment Corporation to invest $50 million in energy, sewage treatment and metal production projects, official says.
- Iraqi brigade sent to Iraq's Umm-Qasr port north of Kuwait.
- Two Kuwaiti holding companies with $500 million capital each to be set up in Egypt.
- Central Bank governor to participate in International Monetary Fund and World Bank meetings in Washington on September 29.
